parts.transcript: Hello, West Bay Laundry. Can I help you? Oh, good morning. I'm ringing about a job - I understand that you have a vacancy? Oh yes, we do. But I'm afraid the person who usually deals with that isn't here today, but I can give you the basic details if you like. That would be great. Could you tell me a little bit more information about the job? Sure. Previously, there was only one branch located on Queens Road. Then we decided to expand our business, so we set up another laundry shop last year and this year we are going to establish five more branches on Beacon Road. Oh, by the way, the one we are recruiting for now is on Hillsdunne Road, just next to a ladies' dress shop. Do you know the area? Yes, I do. I remember there was a special shop where kids were able to find some nice toys, but it went out of business last year. Recently the government is planning to build a department store in this area. Yes, that's true. So ... What kind of job do you offer? Well, if you've learned how to iron clothes, we'll soon have a position for that. I did learn that previously. Oh, I'm also good at taking care of leather. Do you have an opening for that? That's a shame. We don't have many leather clothes at the moment, so there is no vacancy for that. However, we do have a vacant position of washer operators. Okay. And do you know what the rates of pay are? Yes, I've got them here. Let me see ... The hourly rate is $6.50. You know, the average in the city is only $5. Right. And what about lunch breaks, do the staff have to go home to eat or ... No, you don't have to. We offer a free lunch in a restaurant, which is not far from the workplace. The lunch time is one hour, which is generally enough for you to eat and have a rest. Oh wow. Those conditions are better than my last job. And we also offer a morning coffee break, which lasts about 15 minutes. Oh, that's a really good perk. Yes, we think so. And in return for the commitment of loyal staff, we offer 4 weeks' vacation for those who have worked here for three years. Oh, that's good to know. Well, that's for senior staff though. As for the juniors, we will have a training session on every Friday. Oh, I got that wrong, we changed it to every Tuesday since last month. I see. Is there anything else I need to know? We also offer some good fringe benefits to attract the best staff. Really? Yes, of course. For example, we have a staff discount, which is 25 percent off on most products except sales goods. As for the pension, I'm not quite clear about that, but you can ask our personnel manager when you come in for an interview. When would be a good time for me to have the interview? I'm afraid I don't know, but I'll let the manager know you've called so he can arrange a date with you. Thanks, that would be great. Not at all. His office is in Room 12, which is next to Room 10. Oh, please know that we don't have room 11. Thank you. Oh, by the way, who would be my boss exactly? That would be Mrs. Waddell. That's W-A-D-D-E-L-L, Waddell. She's a very energetic woman. Got that. And what would I be doing if I get the job? I mean my duties. Just need to inform you that there is a set of tasks you need to handle besides loading the washing machines. Window dressing is really important to our branch so that's a priority, by which I mean, you have to arrange some of the decorations in our shop window to make it attractive. Another task is watching for shoplifters, for there have been a number of thefts since last September. And you also need to keep an eye on our stock. I see. And is there a uniform? What clothes should I wear? Wearing a black skirt is a must in the workplace. You will also be required to wear a red blouse, which we don't supply unfortunately. A name badge will be given once you get the job and you will have to wear it during the workdays. OK. Is there anything else you would like to know? No, thank you so much for your time. You're welcome. Bye. Bye. Have a nice day.

parts.transcript: Hello, I’m Edward, and I’m here to tell you about road conditions in various areas of the UK. I am also going to tell you about driver’s licences in the UK. If you have never had a driver’s licence, or you have one from another country and you want to get a UK licence, you must be a UK resident. You will need to show a medical report when your UK licence needs to be renewed. If you are trying to translate your original foreign driving licence to apply for a UK licence, which is a must if you want to be able to drive here, you will need to visit an official agency. These are scattered throughout the London area and are well-equipped to assist you with any questions you might have, and any services they offer are included in your licence fee. If you already have a translated licence, but need some personal information updating, you do not need to pay for the update, they’ll do it for free. When you are getting a new driving licence, you may need to have a new photo taken, as some photos are rejected. It’s actually okay if your photo is too small, since we can get it enlarged with our printer. The majority of rejected photos are the ones that were taken with a cream backdrop instead of a monotone grey background. We’ve now found that photos with the latter allow us to identify the licence holder much more easily. If you were wearing glasses on the previous photo, you don't need to worry about it since it is still allowed. If you are not sure whether your previous licence is still valid, then the licence checking service is for you. The procedures are quite clear and you just have to follow them. Ideally, I would like to see the process going faster since it can take hours to finish. From my standpoint, it will help if all the applicants bring the necessary identification with them. Then all they have to do is just fill in the forms accordingly, step by step. I’m often asked whether I have a personal recommendation about the fastest or cheapest place to get all this done, but I think it really depends on where you are. They can all get busy at some point and when it is quiet at one branch it may be busy in another, so take your pick. All I would say is that there is absolutely no difference in price—it’s a standard fee. The only advice I would give is that the quickest way to complete an application is to fill out the form on the internet and then bring a print copy with you to the agency location of your choice. Next, people frequently ask me what I think of the road conditions in some of our cities. London is obviously the biggest and busiest, and there are lots of parking restrictions, one-way systems, and so on, but on the whole, I find the traffic signs are very clear. In Edinburgh, most people use digital maps to get to know local traffic and road conditions, which can be estimated through different traffic flow lines. It is a city of lights, traffic lights, but they’re extremely efficient as they’re timed perfectly to get the traffic flowing smoothly. That’s important because pedestrian areas and crossings are always packed with people on foot, which needs strong regulation. The city of Cardiff has tackled traffic flow in a different way. It recently completed a road expansion scheme, and the extra lanes of the dual-carriageway are easing congestion. It’s a similar story in Manchester, instead of going through the town center, most vehicles choose ring-roads so as to avoid the downtown congestion. It can still happen, though, so there’s a possibility that the city will introduce checkpoints where the police can intervene to direct traffic at peak periods. And finally, they say all roads lead to Rome, and you could say that about Oxford. I like the many options for getting in and out of the city because drivers can always find alternative routes. parts.transcript: Today, advertising plays a key role in how we shop. As regards particular brands and quality, and even our perceived needs, the choices we make are deeply influenced by advertising. Most of us live in large cities, with vast shopping centres offering every kind of product we can imagine. With so many choices out there, manufacturers aim to make their particular products stand out from the rest through advertising. While some people are prepared to travel far to get the specific brand that they want, most people are more likely to buy whatever is on offer in their local area. In spite of the pervasive influence of advertisements, distance plays a fundamental role in our choices, and we can find common brands in almost every store we visit. Advertising can take many different forms, from television and radio advertisements to notices in the local newspaper. While visual aids are very commonly used, sound also generally has the power to influence people. Many advertisements on radio or television include a jingle that people find themselves humming for hours after they hear it. This helps them remember the product on offer, and they are more likely to buy it. Scent is another trick that some businesses like to use. For instance, who can resist entering a shop when the deliciously rich aroma of chocolate hangs in the air as you go by? Scent can be a huge motivating force for customers to buy certain products. Women are attracted to perfume stores by the scents wafting through the door. Culture is one more factor that has significant influence on customers. For example, airline companies usually invest the time and money in producing advertisements in each country in local language so that local people can remember the details in the advertisements. Same rules apply to the international brand products such as Coca Cola and Pepsi. Currently, my research focuses on the reactions that different customers will have, depending on how the products are advertised. After analyzing the data we collected, we have got some interesting findings to share with you. The first finding of the research shows that advertising affects purchase behaviours if the contents accord with audiences' values. These days, as the general public's awareness of environmental protection has arisen, people are more likely to adapt their behaviors when being told that the change would make a difference. For example, the “say no to plastic” advertisement has significantly influenced the customers to protect the environment by bringing their own bags when they go shopping. In light of this, advertising the environmentally friendly aspects of the products gives the customers a positive impression that the manufacturers are also working to capitalise on designing and promoting greener products. People from different age groups also react differently toward advertisements through different mediums. According to the results from the survey, the spending on products promoted on newspapers shows a positive correlation with the buyer's age, which means that older customers are more likely to pay for the products they've seen on this medium. This result isn't out of expectation because younger generations are more used to browsing news online. Another tactic used by many advertising companies that has been found useful in our research is to take into account circumstances of customers in local areas. People's preferences and buying habits are substantially shaped by the environment that they've been living in. It's essential to analyze how the local environment influences people's demands and localize the contents of advertisements accordingly. Our survey into people's perception about local resort advertisement in a coastal city has some interesting findings. Conventionally, a swimming pool is an attraction to many hotel guests. However, our participants were least appealed by this facility in the advertisement but showed most interest in the hotel services and catering. Some of our interviewees explained that they would rather go to the beach to have real water activities. Where an advertisement is to be published or located is also a factor worth considering. Many of you might think that the wider the advertisements are spread, the better the advertising effect there would be. However, it would actually be counterproductive if locations are not carefully selected. For instance, many people driving to tourist attractions, such as national parks, dislike the giant billboards in the middle of their way advertising their destinations, because the advertisements cause distractions and block the road signs they need to see.

task1.title: Task 1: Formal / Semi-formal Letter
task1.prompt: You recently stayed at a hotel on an official business trip and encountered several problems during your stay. Write a formal letter to the hotel manager. In your letter: explain why you were staying at the hotel, describe the problems you experienced, and state what actions you expect the manager to take.
task1.sampleBand8Answer:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to formally register my disappointment regarding the quality of accommodation during my stay at the Grand Imperial Hotel from October 18th to October 21st (Booking Reference: #GI-98421). I was visiting your city as the keynote speaker at the International Energy Symposium.

Regrettably, multiple deficiencies compromised what ought to have been a restful business visit. First, despite confirming a high-floor executive quiet room weeks prior, I was assigned Room 204 adjacent to the main loading dock, where delivery freight commenced noisily at 5:00 AM each morning. Furthermore, the high-speed Wi-Fi connection advertised in the executive suite failed intermittently throughout my stay, preventing me from accessing critical presentation materials for my conference.

To compound these issues, when I raised these urgent concerns with the front desk duty supervisor on the morning of October 19th, the staff member appeared dismissive and failed to offer an alternative room or technical support.

In light of these inconveniences and the substandard service rendered, I request a refund of 50% of the total accommodation fee charged to my corporate card. Additionally, I would appreciate a written assurance detailing the measures you intend to institute to improve staff responsiveness and internet stability.

I look forward to receiving your prompt resolution.

Yours faithfully,
Dr. Jonathan Miller

task2.title: Task 2: General Essay
task2.prompt: In many countries today, people are spending less time with their families and more time at work or pursuing individual hobbies. What are the causes of this trend, and what effects does it have on society?
task2.sampleBand8Answer:
In contemporary society, an increasing number of individuals devote an overwhelming proportion of their daily lives to workplace commitments and autonomous pastimes, resulting in a noticeable decline in familial interaction. This essay will examine the primary catalysts behind this phenomenon and discuss its profound ramifications for community cohesion.

The primary impetus behind diminishing family time is escalating economic pressure and the competitive nature of the globalized job market. With housing costs and general living expenses soaring in metropolitan hubs, adults frequently find themselves obliged to work excessive overtime or manage secondary freelance gigs to attain financial stability. Concurrently, the pervasive presence of personalized digital entertainment—such as algorithmic social media and on-demand streaming—encourages solitary engagement rather than collective domestic pastimes.

Regarding the impacts, this societal transition generates considerable adverse repercussions. Within the household, the lack of parental presence and meaningful communication can weaken intergenerational bonding, leaving children vulnerable to behavioral issues and emotional isolation. At a broader societal level, the erosion of cohesive family structures diminishes the collective resilience of communities, as strong domestic units have traditionally served as the initial safety net during psychological and financial crises.

In summary, intense corporate demands and digital individualism represent the chief reasons why people are drifting from domestic life. Unless societies institute sustainable work-life balance policies, familial ties and social well-being will continue to erode.

questions.sampleBand8: I currently work as a senior software consultant for an international consultancy firm. What captivates me most is the intellectual challenge of engineering scalable architectural solutions that directly streamline daily operations for thousands of corporate end-users.

questions.question: Do you prefer working individually or collaborating in a team?
questions.sampleBand8: While autonomous focus is indispensable for deep coding and analytical tasks, I generally thrive on teamwork. Collaborative brainstorming sessions consistently yield multifaceted perspectives that mitigate blind spots and elevate the overall caliber of our deliverables.

questions.question: How has technological progress transformed your hometown over recent years?
questions.sampleBand8: Remarkably so. Cashless digital payments and app-based public transportation have become completely ubiquitous, which has expedited municipal transit and significantly modernized the pace of urban living.

questions.question: Do you think you will continue living in your current city in the future?
questions.sampleBand8: Most definitely for the foreseeable future. The vibrant economic ecosystem, coupled with rich cultural amenities and extensive professional networks, makes it an ideal launchpad for my ongoing career trajectory.

part2.title: Part 2: Individual Long Turn / Cue Card (3-4 mins)

cueCard.prompt: Describe a memorable professional or academic achievement that you are proud of.
bullets: When and where it took place
What challenges you had to overcome
And explain why you felt so proud of this accomplishment.

part2.sampleBand8Answer:
I would like to speak about a defining professional achievement from last year, when I successfully spearheaded the migration of our company's legacy customer management infrastructure to a secure cloud platform. This undertaking occurred over a grueling six-month period at our regional corporate headquarters.

The primary obstacle we confronted was the sheer complexity of legacy data formats, compounded by an unforgiving deployment deadline. We had to ensure zero downtime for over fifty thousand active global clients while synchronizing disparate legacy databases. Furthermore, midway through the project, several senior specialists had to quarantine due to seasonal health issues, which forced me to shoulder additional architectural duties and coordinate with offshore teams across multiple time zones.

Ultimately, the migration went live seamlessly without a single minute of service disruption. I felt immensely proud not only because the project cut infrastructure overhead by thirty percent, but because it substantiated my leadership capabilities under immense pressure and earned our team formal recognition from executive leadership.

questions.question: Why do some individuals value intrinsic satisfaction over material rewards in their careers?
questions.sampleBand8: Because professional self-actualization provides enduring fulfillment that monetary incentives simply cannot replicate. When employees perceive that their daily contributions generate tangible societal impact, their engagement remains resilient even through arduous economic cycles.

questions.question: Do you believe personal ambition always benefits an organization?
questions.sampleBand8: Not necessarily. While constructive ambition drives innovation and productivity, unbridled personal ambition can foster toxic internal rivalries, undermine collective cohesion, and incentivize unethical shortcuts.

questions.question: How has the definition of effective leadership evolved in the modern era?
questions.sampleBand8: Leadership has fundamentally transitioned from an authoritative, hierarchical command model to an empathetic, servant-leadership philosophy that emphasizes psychological safety, emotional intelligence, and inclusive mentorship.
